Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
